body: Founder tested the WELCOME-time priming fix live and reported the exact same stuck-in-Osaka-Garage symptom. Real gap: that fix sent exactly one priming UserCmd, a single unreliable UDP packet with no retry -- fine over local loopback testing (near-zero packet loss) but a genuinely remote connection over the real internet can lose that one packet and land back in the same stuck state with zero recovery. Now retries on the real per-frame throttle interval until snapshot sync succeeds. Verified live: fresh connect immediately shows cmd_seen=1, player_active=1, and Clients:10, matching the original fix's own verified behavior with real packet-loss resilience added. CI green with a real artifact (ShankPit_Builds_13). Commit 68597e3.
title: Retry the priming UserCmd until sync succeeds, not one shot
